title: Add Deposit is not shown on internal and no-charge work orders
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Approved.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, category Goodwill, in status Approved.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 3, for customer B, in status Approved, billable, so Add Deposit can be seen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open work order 2.
  4. Open the Finance tab.
  5. Open work order 3.
  6. Open the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • "Add Deposit" is not shown.

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 4:

  • "Add Deposit" is not shown.

Step 5:

  • Work order 3 opens.

Step 6:

  • "Add Deposit" is shown.
